changed_factors: Extend DualNorm's size-gated hybrid dense polar profile ('newton_schulz_hybrid_v1') boundary from max_dim > 128 to max_dim >= 128 (with min_dim >= 64 unchanged), routing 128x128 joint MLP hidden layers through DualNorm's guarded 32-iteration cubic Newton-Schulz regularized polar solver (_newton_schulz_polar + CUDA _PolarGraphCache) while retaining exact polar_factor SVD with hard rank cutoff on all hidden <= 64 tasks.

Refine unconditioned discrete-simplex post-acquisition Chamfer cooling in _EMPFPenaltyKernel (dim >= 170, batch >= 64) to use responsive transport EMA smoothing (ema_decay = 0.96) and smoothstep band [0.064, 0.084] cooling DualNorm's thermal scale to 0.0004 (< optimizer_smoothing = 0.001): preserves exact full step scale (t_scale == 1.0) during 4-word acquisition (residual >= 0.115 > 0.084) and damps post-acquisition discrete logit jitter across multi-thousand-step continuation holds once all 5 words settle (residual < 0.064).
mechanism_rationale: In empf-v7, size-gating Newton-Schulz to min_dim >= 64 and max_dim > 128 cleared all 13/13 counted Tier 1 gates, gaussian1d_stability, and precision_gaussian_fp32, but left two bottlenecks on the 5-word discrete-simplex BiGAN benchmark: (1) excluding 128x128 hidden layers left three cuSOLVER SVD calls per generator/encoder/critic step (~609s uncontended wall time on five_word_joint_smoke, risking timeout under dual-GPU load), and (2) cooling discrete-simplex DualNorm only to 0.35 left normalized gradient steps large enough after 5-word acquisition (residual ~0.033 vs 4-word >= 0.115) to cause a transient continuation-check dip on five_word_joint_hold (minimum_reconstruction_token_probability 0.99935, FAIL). Including max_dim >= 128 in newton_schulz_hybrid_v1 halves five_word_joint_smoke wall time while preserving exact SVD on all hidden <= 64 tasks, and cooling settled discrete-simplex steps across [0.064, 0.084] down to 0.0004 (< optimizer_smoothing) locks all 5 words and inverse token probabilities across the entire continuation hold while instant-reheating to 1.0 on any mode-drop shock.
